title: When your familiar answers are no longer enough.
subtitle: You can come with a specific decision, a recurring pattern, or an inner tension that is hard to name. Together, we clarify the question, uncover connections, and bring emotional, bodily, and relational experience alongside analytical understanding.

direction.title: Several important considerations pull in different directions
direction.description: You are not choosing between right and wrong; several values, relationships, possibilities, or visions of the future are in conflict.

patterns.title: You understand it intellectually, yet it does not change
patterns.description: You can see the pattern clearly, yet keep arriving at the same place. We look at what sustains it beyond thought.

overload.title: You function well, but at a growing cost
overload.description: Things look fine from the outside, while tension, exhaustion, or distance from how you want to live is growing within.

values.title: Your earlier goals no longer show you what comes next
values.description: There may be no crisis. What used to motivate and guide you no longer fully fits what matters to you now. You want to see more clearly what is taking shape in its place.

approach.title: We hold a wider picture so you can choose more freely.
approach.description: Thoughts, emotions, bodily signals, relational patterns, values, and environmental conditions all offer points of orientation. The aim is not a final explanation, but greater awareness and more genuine choices.

notice.title: Clarify
notice.description: We distinguish facts, interpretations, emotions, and bodily signals so that what is happening becomes more visible.

understand.title: See in context
understand.description: We look at how the present situation connects with your history, relationships, values, and environment.

move.title: Choose more freely
move.description: We connect insight to a next step or a new way of relating that you can try in everyday life.

contact.title: Book your first session
contact.description: Choose from the available times shown. After booking, you receive the calendar invitation by email.

first.title: A first 55-minute session
first.description: We get to know each other, explore what brought you here, and clarify together what you want to understand or change and what the focus of our work should be.

continue.title: We agree on how to work together
continue.description: If we both feel it makes sense to continue, we agree on the focus of the work, meeting every one or two weeks, and the other important boundaries of our collaboration.
